rag_questions.question: What HTTP endpoint is used to dynamically load a LoRA adapter?
rag_questions.answer: Send a POST request to /v1/load_lora_adapter with the adapter name and path.

rag_questions.question: Which flag enables LoRA support when starting the engine?
Which environment variable allows loading LoRA adapters at runtime?
On which port does the OpenAI compatible server listen by default?
rag_questions.answer: Port 8000; it can be changed with --port.

rag_questions.question: How do clients authenticate against the server when an API key is set?
rag_questions.answer: They send the key in the Authorization: Bearer header.

rag_questions.question: Which quantization methods does the engine support?
rag_questions.answer: AWQ, GPTQ and FP8, selected with --quantization.

rag_questions.question: What happens with FP8 on GPUs without native FP8 support?
rag_questions.answer: It falls back to a weight-only FP8 kernel: less memory, no speed-up.

rag_questions.question: When is sampling greedy in SamplingParams?
What values of top_p are accepted by SamplingParams.verify?
What is the default block size of the KV cache?
What does KVCacheManager.allocate do when there are not enough free blocks?
rag_questions.answer: It raises MemoryError and the request is preempted.
